subject: qilin
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: qilin, scaled hooved chimera with antlers and cloud mane.
Style: high-fantasy anime.
reasoning:
I'm keeping scope manageable given the effort constraints but want it solid: a quadruped qilin with a dragon-ish head, antlers, cloud-mane details, scaled body, hooves, and a flame tail, built from the builder API patterns I've seen like joints, chains, limbs, sweeps, lofts, and spikes.

I'm sketching out the skeleton and proportions—hip and chest positions, spine/neck/tail chains, and leg geometry using the limb-with-bends approach from the pegasus example, adjusting lengths so they sum correctly to reach each foot. I'm also planning the tail flame cards and mane cloud texture using svg cards placed along the neck sweep.

For the antlers I'm using bezier catmull curves with branching, tapered sweep radii, and pointed caps, while the eyes will be decals placed on the skull surface using position and direction vectors similar to the pegasus setup.

I'm working out the head joint placement extending from the neck end, defining forward-down direction vectors to loft skull stations, then adding gold hoof cylinders and a scale-based paint function that counter-shades the belly versus the rest of the body based on normal direction, with hooves sized to touch the ground plane.

Now I'm checking total height proportions with the antler tips topping out around 2.3, then deciding whether to add glow effects to the flame tail card meshes and a forehead gem, using the frame function at the tail's end point to orient those cards before finalizing the code.
